title: EnvelopeFile Debug derive leaks PII email addresses to logs
description: EnvelopeFile now derives Debug. The struct contains mail_from (String) and rcpt_to (Vec<String>) — both are PII email addresses. Debug output via {:?} or dbg!() is a common logging/debugging pattern. A future contributor adding debug instrumentation or using dbg!() in relay_queue.rs would silently emit PII to logs with no redaction. The struct is private to the module but tests import it via super::*. Consequence: any debug log of EnvelopeFile reveals sender/recipient email addresses. Consider impl fmt::Debug manually with <redacted> for the address fields, or document why plain Debug is safe.
